products.tagline: Variables-first Figma system with 600+ components, light and dark modes.

products.title: Launchpad — Next.js SaaS Starter
products.tagline: Auth, Stripe subscriptions, Postgres and a marketing site, wired together and tested.
products.description:
Launchpad gives you the first three weeks of a SaaS build on day one.

Authentication, subscription billing, a Postgres schema with migrations, transactional email and a marketing site are already connected and covered by end-to-end tests.

### What's included
- Next.js App Router project with TypeScript
- Stripe Checkout, customer portal and webhook handlers
- Drizzle ORM schema for users, teams and subscriptions
- MDX blog and docs
- Deployment guide for Vercel and Fly.io
features: Next.js App Router with server actions
Marketing site, blog and docs pages
products.targetAudience: Indie hackers and small teams launching a subscription product who want the boring parts done right.
products.seoDescription: Auth, Stripe subscriptions, Postgres and a marketing site, wired together and tested.

products.title: Orbit — SaaS Admin Dashboard
products.tagline: A React + Tailwind admin with auth screens, billing, team management and 40+ pages.
products.description:
Orbit is the admin dashboard we kept rebuilding for client SaaS projects, finally packaged properly.

It ships as a Vite + React 19 app with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 and a small set of headless primitives, so it reads like code you would have written yourself. Pages are wired with mock data and typed API hooks; swap in your backend and go.

### What's included
- 42 pages: overview, analytics, customers, billing, invoices, team, settings, auth
- 70+ components with keyboard and screen-reader support
- Light and dark themes driven by CSS variables
- Figma file with matching components and auto-layout
features: 42 responsive pages incl. billing, teams and settings
React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS v4
Recharts analytics widgets with dark mode
products.targetAudience: SaaS founders and front-end developers who need a production-grade admin without building the shell from scratch.
products.seoDescription: A React + Tailwind admin with auth screens, billing, team management and 40+ pages.
